newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Napocor 1997 capex up at 35.976 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Napocor 1997 capex up at 35.976 bln pesos.

text.p: The Philippines' National Power Corp (Napocor) said on Monday it will require 35.976 billion pesos for its 1997 capital investment programme, up 37.26 percent from 26.209 billion pesos in 1996.
Napocor documents showed that bulk of the investments, 18.474 billion pesos or 51.35 percent, will be used for transmission projects.
Some 6.043 billion pesos will be spent for plant rehabilitation and expansion while 5.812 billion pesos will be earmarked for power generation projects, the documents showed.
The state-owned power firm said it will have to set aside 2.438 billion pesos to cover loan interests.
The required capital expenditure will be sourced from loans, proceeds of bond issues and internally-generated cash.
Napocor controls the power generation and transmission sector in the Philippines.
